text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the February Stakes.<n>Many
spectators poke fun at the<n>event, labelling it a
showdown<n>between the biter and the pip-squeak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Shinko Windy herself isn't<n>laughing. She
declares that today is<n>the day she's going to run
faster<n>than anyone and turn public opinion of<n>her on
its head.
